prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System: advisory-only; command-authority/continuity preserved. Actors: local fire agencies/county emergency management/state wildland fire resources/aviation support units/cooperating public safety partners. North Lookout Camera Mast→Thermal Spot Snippet/bearings; South Lookout Camera Mast→triangulation/Camera Cleaning Log; both→health. Smoke Classifier Module→smoke/growth/confidence/Ridge Shadow Mask; contamination-checks. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine(Lantern)→traceable detections/perimeters/recommendations/hazards/probability-bands; degradation-downweighted; retains approved configuration during repository-outage. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node(Brindle)→terrain-weather/Wind Shift Bulletin/exposure-flags/cache. Caldera Incident Command Portal(Emberhall)→triage/approval/assignments; mandatory perimeter/priority-review. Duty Detection Officer(Orion)→verification; receives stale/partial-coverage warnings. Confirmed Ignition State requires persistent smoke/thermal+corroboration/authorized-judgment; ≠dispatch. Disconnected-mode: timestamped cache/queues; irreversible-release blocked. Crewline Mobile Tablet→encrypted queues; reconciliation preserves author/device-time/server-acceptance-time. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock(Kestrel)→readiness/health/recovery; maintenance controller→Battery Swap Ticket. Drone Tasking Service→missions/windows/images/altitudes/abort-criteria/status; degraded-communications release requires corridor-permit. Drone Pilot Operator→endurance/routes/return/separation-checks. Air Attack Supervisor(Redtail)→aviation-authorization/seasonal-readiness-evidence-confirmation. Airspace Restricted State requires accepted routes/altitudes/helitack-boundary. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console(Marigold) blocks unapproved/unready-release→Runway Release Note/Suppression Drop Receipt. Tanker Base Manager reconciles East Retardant Loading Pump→Retardant Batch Slip; East/West Retardant Loading Pump→state/flow/outages; loading≠approval. Records: policy-retention/encryption/controlled-export/authorized-deletion; operational-user training mandatory. Deployment governance board includes operational-leadership/maintenance/information-security/detection/aviation/ground-crew/county-coordination representatives; seasonal-approval requires residual-risk/staffing/baselines/prior-corrective-actions review. Pre-service acceptance: Portal/Analytics/Classifier

New part:
S239: Each after-action review shall reconstruct the timeline from system logs, user accounts, communications records, and maintenance notes without assigning blame to individual operators.
S240: Review facilitators shall document what was expected to happen, what actually happened, why differences occurred, and which corrective actions are necessary before the next readiness cycle.
S241: Corrective actions shall be entered into a controlled improvement backlog with assigned ownership, target completion dates, verification methods, and linkage to the originating event.
S242: Data stewardship shall define retention, access control, quality review, and disposition rules for operational records, sensor data, model outputs, configuration records, and user activity records.
S243: Operational data used for model evaluation shall be protected from unauthorized alteration and shall preserve enough context to support later engineering review and regulatory inquiry.
S244: Changes to the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine or Smoke Classifier Module shall be evaluated with representative seasonal data before deployment to confirm that detection performance improves without unacceptable increases in false alerts.
S245: Configuration changes to field equipment shall be versioned, reviewed, and tested in a nonoperational environment before being promoted into the seasonal baseline.
S246: At the end of each fire season, the governance board shall compare system performance, operational workload, maintenance burden, and user feedback against the acceptance criteria approved for that season.
S247: The resulting improvement plan shall define which procedures, training materials, interfaces, algorithms, and support arrangements will be revised before the next seasonal readiness campaign begins.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
